o0.heading: Which language do you want to use?
o0.sub: You can change the language again later if you want.

o1.heading: Which team do you play for?
o1.sub: Ask your coach for the team's code. No team yet? Make up your own code and we'll help you start one.

o1a.heading: We couldn't find a team with the code {{inviteCode}}
o1a.sub: Is it a new team? Give it a name and we'll create it for you.
o1a.codeLabel: Team code — share it with your teammates so they can join
o1a.permanentTip: The name and the code can't be changed later, so double-check they're right!
o1a.wrongCode: I think I typed the code wrong

o3.heading: Choose your player name
o3.sub: This is the name your team sees — not your real name unless you want it to be.
o3.helper: No photo needed — pick a character you like.

o4.heading: What year were you born?
o4.sub: We use it to tailor challenges to your age.

o5.consentHeading: We're asking an adult for permission
o5.verifyBody1: Before you can start logging training, you need to verify your email or phone number.
o5.consentBody1: Before you can start logging training, a parent or guardian needs to say yes.
o5.verifyBody2: We'll send a verification link — you confirm with one tap.
o5.consentBody2: We'll send them a quick question — they approve with one tap.
o5.consentContactLabel: Parent's or guardian's email or phone number
o5.verifyHelper: We only use it to verify your account — nothing else.
o5.consentHelper: We only use it to ask permission — nothing else.
o5.coachNote: Coaches: help the player fill this in if they're unsure what to enter.

o6.foundingBody: You're the team's first player — and captain! As soon as a parent or guardian says yes, you can start logging training and inviting teammates.
o6.joinedBody: You're in {{teamName}}! We've sent a request to a parent or guardian. As soon as they say yes, you can start logging training and earning points for the team.

ra1.heading: Already have an account?
ra1.sub: Enter the team code and your username, and we'll send a login code to your (or your parent's) email.

ra2.heading: Check your inbox
ra2.sub: If your details matched, we've sent a code to your (or your parent's) email. Enter it below to log in again.
ra2.invalidCodeError: That code doesn't work anymore. Check you typed it right, or ask for a new one.
ra2.retryLink: Didn't get a code? Try again

flow.screenNameTaken: That name is already taken on the team — try another one!
flow.teamNameRejected: The name or team code contained words that don't work here. Rewrite the name, or tap "Change code" above if that's the problem.
flow.codeTakenConcurrently: Oh no — someone else created a team with that code just before you! Try another code, and we'll sort out the rest right away.
flow.inviteCodeNotFound: That team code doesn't work anymore. Ask your coach for a new one.
flow.invalidParentContact: That contact info doesn't look right — check that it's a real email address or phone number.
flow.invalidScreenName: That name doesn't quite work — try another one!
flow.invalidBirthYear: Hmm, that year doesn't look right. Try again.
flow.genericValidationError: Something went wrong. Check your details and try again.

shared.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
